name: Golden Raisins
siboNotes: Small portions are generally well-tolerated, but dried fruits can be more concentrated in sugars and may trigger symptoms in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Start with small portions (1 tablespoon) to test tolerance
Soak briefly in warm water to soften if needed for baking
Store in airtight container to maintain freshness
Check labels for added sugars or preservatives
alternatives: Fresh grapes (low FODMAP up to 1 cup)
Small portions of other dried fruits within limits
pairsWellWith: Low FODMAP nuts like almonds or walnuts
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of potassium for heart health
Natural source of quick energy from natural sugars
